PLAN "Perimenopause Strength & Bone Density - 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maximise bone loading via heavy compounds"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Re-establish Heavy Loading" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 2m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          farmers_walk 3x40 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 55m "Upper - Press Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          arm_circles 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Lower - Hinge Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          glute_bridge 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 3x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          suitcase_carry 3x30 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          pigeon_pose 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper - Pull Focus + Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
          arm_circles 2m
          external_rotation 2m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dip 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
